description: What every player gets on joining the map and on every respawn (tools/configure_spawn_loadout.py; granted by kt_spawn_supply_service in SpawnSupplies.verse). The same consumables are removed first so stacks never pile up. Player 2026-10-10: pistol, shields, meds and slurp fish.
slurp_fish_note: Slurp fish exists in this UEFN build only as an entity item (/EntityItems/_Verse.Items-Slurpfish_BR_CH2S1_Epic), which item granters refuse; slurp juice stands in until a grantable slurp fish is found.
